limitations: Patient ids are unavailable for aptos, ddr, idrid; those domains are split at image level, so same-patient images could in principle span splits. This cannot be detected or prevented from the released data and is reported as a limitation of the datasets, not of the protocol.
Content hashing detects byte-identical files only. The same photograph re-encoded or resized would not be flagged; near-duplicate detection would require perceptual hashing.
